Separately, `GroupsController#members` changes from `render_serialized(members, ...)` to a new JSON envelope `{ members: ..., meta: { total, limit, offset } }` (and JS `Group#findMembers` now relies on `result.meta`/`result.members`), but the diff adds no controller spec covering this new public response shape.
